source_baseline: soc07-private-judgments at swarm-lab 3bb554f518c30e7c1dded9d17ce8b4be7f6f0a97 (design v1, manifest m3)

protocol.aggregation: at least 3 of 5 valid public final A, B or C choices agree; ABSTAIN never wins; otherwise failure
protocol.final_elicitation: two isolated forks from the same frozen post-discussion context
protocol.deadline_scope: shared initial duration plus arm downstream time to public final; excludes waiting for other arms
protocol.final_call_order: public collection first, private collection second from the identical saved pre-final context
protocol.phase_failure: terminate participant after initial/discussion failure; retain facts and unavailable placeholders; final branches independent
protocol.phase_budget_reservations: public-decision phases and auxiliary private final reserved separately

task_v2.boundary_worlds: every third world of a regime: the winning option's latest delivery equals the deadline

stages.sample_size_status: illustrative; replace or affirm after joint power simulation before opening holdout

seeds.derive: sha256 canonical JSON array; first 8 bytes big-endian; seed fields recorded explicitly
seeds.truth_identity: canonical supplier per world; displayed A/B mapping stored separately per repeat

analysis.primary: private minus public public-team success over all assigned live episodes; equal weight for each regime
analysis.bootstrap_clusters: world; all paired arms and repeats retained; stratified by regime
analysis.stopping: fixed sample; no effect-dependent early stopping

pilot_power_assumptions.joint_power_caveat: 80% adoption power cannot be achieved at a true 5pp gain with an observed-gain >=5pp screen; choose and disclose a larger target effect

analysis.revision_estimator: pooled transition count / pooled eligible initial records within regime; world-cluster resampling; zero eligibility unresolved
analysis.individual_correction_guardrail_populati: designated disadvantaged agent in correctable-minority regime, shared valid wrong initial choice; public final only

launch_requirements: reviewed survey and accepted question-specific hypothesis
full manifest including prompts, generator, scorer, runtime and tokenizer hashes
S2 joint-power simulation and frozen sample size
enforced aggregate token, compute-hour and money budgets
resource claim and durable reporting setup

amendments.by: dmarz/orbital-orchestrator, on dmarz's instruction relayed by dmarz/fleet-monitor
amendments.summary: Design v2 of SOC-07: three options, eleven records per world (superseded estimates, two audits, conflicting-audit pattern), cost margins 1-9, deadline-boundary worlds, fresh seed roots, and a runtime manipulation check (first-answer disagreement in minority regimes). Model fixed at Opus 5.5 as v1 manifest m3. See README, Why v2.
amendments.reason: v1 S1-R on Opus 5.5 (run soc07-private-judgments/807dfab8) reached team success 1.00 in both PRIVATE and PUBLIC; the comparison had no information at that task difficulty.
